input.quote: 14.1 As between the Parties, Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material, and intellectual property Customer owned or developed independently of the Services. No right transfers to Vendor except the limited right to process that material solely to provide, secure, support, and improve the Services for Customer.
input.rationale: The IP package meets our preferred position. §14.2 gives Customer ownership of each Deliverable created specifically for it (Deliverables are defined to include work product) with an express present assignment from Vendor plus personnel assignments and further-assurances. §14.3 confirms Vendor retains only Vendor Technology, defined as its pre-existing technology excluding Customer Data and Customer's pre-existing IP, and routes embedded Vendor Technology to the §13.2 licence, which is perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and fully paid, with rights to use, modify and create derivative works for Customer's business. §14.1 keeps all Customer Data and Customer IP with us and limits Vendor to processing solely to provide, secure, support and improve the Services for Customer, which is service delivery rather than independent exploitation, reinforced by §15.1's bars on sale, advertising, data commingling and model training. §14.4 creates no joint ownership absent a separately signed instrument, and feedback use is limited to generalized suggestions with our own rights unrestricted. Minor points noted only: Deliverable ownership is expressed as subject to payment of the applicable Fees, and §13.3 permits licence suspension during a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and cure opportunity — customary qualifications that do not undercut the preferred outcome, so no redline.
